landing.metaTitle: ChainCompass — on-chain clarity for long-term investors
landing.metaDescription: Understand blockchain health with transparent, evidence-based analysis.
landing.title: See the network behind the numbers.
landing.description: Clear, evidence-based on-chain analysis for long-term investors. Understand what is happening across major networks, with context and uncertainty in view.
landing.scope: Starting with Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Chain.
landing.disclaimer: For information only. Not financial advice and never a buy or sell signal.
landing.sampleHeading: A clearer view of network activity
landing.sampleNote: Illustrative values show formatting only; they are not live market data.

landingV1.headline: Understand the networks you follow.
landingV1.subheadline: A calm, clear view of blockchain health for long-term investors. Explore the evidence, understand uncertainty, and make your own decisions.
landingV1.supportedChains: Starting with Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Chain.
landingV1.featuresTitle: A clearer way to read on-chain data
landingV1.featuresDescription: Useful context and transparent evidence, without turning analysis into a trading instruction.
landingV1.healthDescription: See key network indicators in one explainable score, with the underlying metrics close at hand.
landingV1.alertsDescription: Notice meaningful changes with plain-language context, not alarmist prompts or trade calls.
landingV1.analystDescription: Ask questions and explore cited data. The agent only reports numbers returned by its analysis tools.
landingV1.howDescription: From source data to understandable context in three transparent steps.
landingV1.step1Description: Collect on-chain and market context from documented, replaceable data providers.
landingV1.step2Description: Use transparent rules and clear metric definitions to summarize network conditions.
landingV1.step3Description: Review changes, uncertainty, and freshness before drawing your own conclusions.
landingV1.promiseDescription: Useful analysis should be clear about what it can and cannot tell you.
landingV1.promise1: Analysis and context, never financial advice.
landingV1.promise2: Historical scenarios communicate ranges, not price predictions.
landingV1.promise3: Methods, evidence, uncertainty, and data freshness stay visible.
landingV1.disclaimer: ChainCompass is for informational purposes only. It is not financial, investment, or trading advice and does not recommend buying or selling any asset.
landingV1.finalDescription: Explore on-chain evidence at your own pace. No trading calls, no promised outcomes.
